title: Cursed world
description: A glitch-horror themed mod for Forge 1.8.9 featuring a short cinematic event sequence that eventually restores the world back to normal. Beta version.
body:
## Description

Curse Client is a mod for Minecraft 1.8.9 that puts the world into a broken, eerie, glitch-like horror atmosphere. Through HUD errors, distorted visuals, and audio anomalies, it creates a short cinematic experience. Once the story is completed, all effects are disabled and the game's settings/biome values return to normal.

Since this is a beta version, performance and behavior may still change. Feedback is highly appreciated.

## Features

- Glitch-horror atmosphere (HUD error texts, noise overlays, distorted sounds)
- Cinematic story event featuring The581953 and The1545
- Automatically restores the game to normal after the story ends
- Effect intensity balanced to keep the game playable
- Fully client-side visual and audio experience

## Story Flow

- The581953 “joins” the world after a certain time and starts sending disturbing messages
- The1545 appears and starts a dialogue
- They fight in front of the player (no death, only visual effects)
- The1545 wins and The581953 gets “banned”
- The mod disables all glitch effects and the game returns to normal

## Beta Warning

- This version is still in beta, so performance and effect intensity may change
- Some systems may experience FPS drops
- Adjustments will be made based on feedback

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.8.9
- Forge 11.15.1.2318

## Installation

- Place the modid-1.0.jar file into the mods folder
- Launch the game using Forge 1.8.9

## Known Issues

- Heavy effects may reduce FPS on lower-end systems
- Since this is a beta version, some scenes may have minor timing inconsistencies
